narration: In March 2026, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman paused Gateway, a planned outpost in lunar orbit.
visual_brief: Gateway outpost hardware concept in lunar orbit above the Moon.

candidates.title: jsc2024e025315
candidates.description: Gateway's HALO (Habitation and Logistics Outpost) module is one of four of Gateway's pressurized modules where international teams of astronauts will live, conduct science, and prepare for missions to the lunar South Pole region from Gateway. HALO is provided by Northrop Grumman.
